speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about the bleeding from your wisdom tooth extraction and how long it has persisted? Also, have you noticed any other unusual bleeding or bruising in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you or your family members experience bleeding into joints or muscles, and have you noticed prolonged bleeding after other surgeries or dental procedures? REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Prothrombin Time: 15 sec, Partial Thromboplastin Time: 60 sec

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of easy bruising, prolonged mucosal bleeding after dental work, and a family history of joint swelling strongly suggests Hemophilia. I will request specific factor assays to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Factor VIII and Factor IX levels

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Factor VIII: Normal, Factor IX: Reduced

speaker: Doctor
text: Your test results show normal Factor VIII levels but reduced Factor IX, which confirms a diagnosis of Hemophilia B. This condition explains your easy bruising, prolonged bleeding after dental extraction, and the family history of joint swelling. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia B
